verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API with token-based API keys, the `fhcli` command-line tool and an official MCP server, but none of these is an official language SDK. No SDK (e.g. Go, Python or TypeScript client libraries) appears anywhere in the pack, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.
